correctness.rationale: An occupied row or column observes its entire line, leaving exactly U×V unobserved. Unique-neighbor forcing succeeds exactly when |U|≤1 or |V|≤1, and fails with at least two unoccupied rows and columns. Every minimal set is a row or column basis. One spare cell connects all row bases/column bases; exact-budget extra column bases are isolated; symmetric square overlap and m=2 boundaries are explicit. Eight boards checked by exhaustive independent rule simulation and BFS, with finite scope stated.
